sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''Business in Rotterdam'''

[[Lok]], [[Sophie]], and [[Cherit]] are in [[:Category:Rotterdam, Netherlands|Rotterdam]] on a mission to deliver the Amulet of [[Vigilante]] to a Huntik Foundation safehouse. Because Vigilante previously belonged to an evil Seeker, its dark energy will naturally attract evil Seekers.
Unbeknownst to them, two [[Silent Soldiers]] are watching them from a rooftop. 

Meanwhile, [[Zhalia]] is taking time off for personal business and returns to her childhood [[Rotterdam Orphanage|orphanage]], reflecting on her own dark past following her home in Vienna burning down. She sees one orphan, [[Harrison Fears|Harrison]], being targeted by bullies but his brother [[Den Fears|Den]] intervenes and fights the bullies, [[Bruno]] and [[Dirk]]. During the fight, Den manifests a Seeker power, much to his amazement. The Blood Spiral [[Tantras]] arrives posing as a talent scout offering the orphans a way out. Zhalia alerts [[Dante]] who is attending a meeting with the [[Huntik Foundation Council]] in New York. He warns the council that the Spirals are on the move. 

'''Training the Orphans'''

Recognizing Harrison's anger, isolation, and resentment toward the world, Tantras manipulates him into embracing his hatred and fear. Harrison gives in to the dark power and successfully bonds with the Titan [[Marauder]], who advances on Bruno and Dirk. Seeing their fear, Tantras gives them each a [[Harlekin]] Amulet and manipulates them into summoning their Titans. A scuffle ensues, with Marauder ovepowering one of the Harlekins but the other tries to attack Harrison. Den rushes in to protect him and blasts the Titan back to its Amulet. Harrison tells Den to calm down; he is enjoying having this newfound power. Zhalia, who has been watching nearby, tries to advise the boys against trusting the Blood Spirals, drawing on her own experience as a former misguided orphan. However, Harrison ignores her and warns her off, fully intent on joining the Blood Spirals. 

Tantras teaches the orphans to control their Titans, creating [[Fog Monster]]s for them to defeat. Den is unable to summon Marauder much to Tantras' disgust. He demands that Den attack one of his former bullies as a test, but Den refuses to participate in the cruel games. Tantras threatens to leave Den behind to rot at the orphanage while Harrison reprimands Den for holding him back and warns him to not mess it up for him.

'''Under Pursuit'''

As Lok, Sophie, and Cherit navigate Rotterdam's winding streets toward the safe house, they run into the Silent Soldiers in an alley. Lok uses the [[Willblade]] to fight their Marauder who Cherit defeats with an energy charge. The Spirals flee, but Sophie is suspicious why they didn't put up much of a fight. Later, they realize they are being tailed by Blood Spiral soldiers. Lok uses a new spell [[Rearview]] to confirm the pursuit. To avoid leading enemies straight to the Huntik Foundation's secret base, Lok and Sophie attempt a diversion, using [[Featherdrop]] simultaneously to jump down between two skyscrapers and send them in the wrong direction. 

As night falls, [[Rassimov]] meets Tantras' four new recruits and endows them with the tattoo of the Blood Spiral. Den is terrified and runs away to find Zhalia, who assures him he did the right thing. Harrison arrives looking for Den but Den refuses to hurt anyone for no good reason. Intoxicated by his power, Harrison turns hostile towards his brother and leaves with Tantras, who tells Zhalia that one day she will desire the power of the Blood Spiral too. 

'''Battle on the Erasmus Bridge''' 

Tantras brings Harrison, Bruno and Dirk to the [[Erasmus Bridge]] for their final initiation test: attacking Lok and Sophie. The orphans rush into the fight willingly and engage in combat with the Huntik Seekers. Zhalia arrives to assist Lok and Sophie but Tantras summons his own Titan, [[Jericho]]. [[Shauna]] and [[Wind]] are on their way to assist Tantras, but are jumped by Dante who invokes [[Caliban]]. Together they defeat [[Ash]] and [[Dervish]], and Dante uses [[Stopglue]] to stick the enemy Seekers to the ground so he can help the others. 

During the chaotic battle, Lok the amulet of Vigilante drops to the ground. Harrison rushes to claim it for himself but Den reaches it first and  instantly bonds with the Titan, invoking it. Harrison is furious and begins to throttle Den, weakening Vigilante in the process for Harlekin to defeat him. Lok steps in and blasts Harrison away with a [[Touchram]] and helps Den. Zhalia invokes [[King Basilisk]] who defeats Jericho. Dante arrives to help the team, and Caliban defeats Harlekin, pushing back Tantras and his forces. Realizing they are outmatched, Tantras uses [[Darkfog]] to mask their retreat. Back at the orphanage, he welcomes Harrison with into the Blood Spiral order.

At [[Dante Vale's house|Dante's house]], although Den is devastated by his brother's turn to darkness, Dante and Zhalia welcome him into the Huntik Foundation. Den vows to train as a Seeker so he can one day save Harrison from the Blood Spirals. Sophie apologises for messing up the delivery, but Dante is pleased; the long-term objective was to find a good Seeker to bond with Vigilante, and Den is exactly that.

Vienna, Austria

Zhalia leads the Huntik team into Klaus' library to find the Amulet of Void. Both the Foundation and the Organization are ambushed by a devastating new menace, the Blood Spirals, led by their old foe, Rassimov. Dante manages to save himself by bonding with Powerbonded Caliban, but the Spirals are too strong. Void ends up in their hands.

plot_sections.heading: Plot
plot_sections.wikitext:
'''Business in Rotterdam'''

[[Lok]], [[Sophie]], and [[Cherit]] are in [[:Category:Rotterdam, Netherlands|Rotterdam]] on a mission to deliver the Amulet of [[Vigilante]] to a Huntik Foundation safehouse. Because Vigilante previously belonged to an evil Seeker, its dark energy will naturally attract evil Seekers.
Unbeknownst to them, two [[Silent Soldiers]] are watching them from a rooftop. 

Meanwhile, [[Zhalia]] is taking time off for personal business and returns to her childhood [[Rotterdam Orphanage|orphanage]], reflecting on her own dark past following her home in Vienna burning down. She sees one orphan, [[Harrison Fears|Harrison]], being targeted by bullies but his brother [[Den Fears|Den]] intervenes and fights the bullies, [[Bruno]] and [[Dirk]]. During the fight, Den manifests a Seeker power, much to his amazement. The Blood Spiral [[Tantras]] arrives posing as a talent scout offering the orphans a way out. Zhalia alerts [[Dante]] who is attending a meeting with the [[Huntik Foundation Council]] in New York. He warns the council that the Spirals are on the move. 

'''Training the Orphans'''

Recognizing Harrison's anger, isolation, and resentment toward the world, Tantras manipulates him into embracing his hatred and fear. Harrison gives in to the dark power and successfully bonds with the Titan [[Marauder]], who advances on Bruno and Dirk. Seeing their fear, Tantras gives them each a [[Harlekin]] Amulet and manipulates them into summoning their Titans. A scuffle ensues, with Marauder ovepowering one of the Harlekins but the other tries to attack Harrison. Den rushes in to protect him and blasts the Titan back to its Amulet. Harrison tells Den to calm down; he is enjoying having this newfound power. Zhalia, who has been watching nearby, tries to advise the boys against trusting the Blood Spirals, drawing on her own experience as a former misguided orphan. However, Harrison ignores her and warns her off, fully intent on joining the Blood Spirals. 

Tantras teaches the orphans to control their Titans, creating [[Fog Monster]]s for them to defeat. Den is unable to summon Marauder much to Tantras' disgust. He demands that Den attack one of his former bullies as a test, but Den refuses to participate in the cruel games. Tantras threatens to leave Den behind to rot at the orphanage while Harrison reprimands Den for holding him back and warns him to not mess it up for him.

'''Under Pursuit'''

As Lok, Sophie, and Cherit navigate Rotterdam's winding streets toward the safe house, they run into the Silent Soldiers in an alley. Lok uses the [[Willblade]] to fight their Marauder who Cherit defeats with an energy charge. The Spirals flee, but Sophie is suspicious why they didn't put up much of a fight. Later, they realize they are being tailed by Blood Spiral soldiers. Lok uses a new spell [[Rearview]] to confirm the pursuit. To avoid leading enemies straight to the Huntik Foundation's secret base, Lok and Sophie attempt a diversion, using [[Featherdrop]] simultaneously to jump down between two skyscrapers and send them in the wrong direction. 

As night falls, [[Rassimov]] meets Tantras' four new recruits and endows them with the tattoo of the Blood Spiral. Den is terrified and runs away to find Zhalia, who assures him he did the right thing. Harrison arrives looking for Den but Den refuses to hurt anyone for no good reason. Intoxicated by his power, Harrison turns hostile towards his brother and leaves with Tantras, who tells Zhalia that one day she will desire the power of the Blood Spiral too. 

'''Battle on the Erasmus Bridge''' 

Tantras brings Harrison, Bruno and Dirk to the [[Erasmus Bridge]] for their final initiation test: attacking Lok and Sophie. The orphans rush into the fight willingly and engage in combat with the Huntik Seekers. Zhalia arrives to assist Lok and Sophie but Tantras summons his own Titan, [[Jericho]]. [[Shauna]] and [[Wind]] are on their way to assist Tantras, but are jumped by Dante who invokes [[Caliban]]. Together they defeat [[Ash]] and [[Dervish]], and Dante uses [[Stopglue]] to stick the enemy Seekers to the ground so he can help the others. 

During the chaotic battle, Lok the amulet of Vigilante drops to the ground. Harrison rushes to claim it for himself but Den reaches it first and  instantly bonds with the Titan, invoking it. Harrison is furious and begins to throttle Den, weakening Vigilante in the process for Harlekin to defeat him. Lok steps in and blasts Harrison away with a [[Touchram]] and helps Den. Zhalia invokes [[King Basilisk]] who defeats Jericho. Dante arrives to help the team, and Caliban defeats Harlekin, pushing back Tantras and his forces. Realizing they are outmatched, Tantras uses [[Darkfog]] to mask their retreat. Back at the orphanage, he welcomes Harrison with into the Blood Spiral order.

At [[Dante Vale's house|Dante's house]], although Den is devastated by his brother's turn to darkness, Dante and Zhalia welcome him into the Huntik Foundation. Den vows to train as a Seeker so he can one day save Harrison from the Blood Spirals. Sophie apologises for messing up the delivery, but Dante is pleased; the long-term objective was to find a good Seeker to bond with Vigilante, and Den is exactly that.
